svg.text: Smart-bypass retrofit unit - every part from the 'Retrofit Economics' slide, pulled apart along its mounting axis
Teal dashes: the straight-line path each part follows when assembled.
Navy dashes: lid screws down onto the four corners of the enclosure.
Orange dashes: the OLED rises into the window cut in the lid.
Same numbers as the list on the right (and the slide). Where a number appears twice, the
part is fitted twice: TDS inlet + output, flow purified + reject, valve bypass + RO.
Water goes through the sensor bank first, then the two valves choose bypass or RO
(slide 6). 'E' is the enclosure: base, lid, standoffs and tube fittings.
Part sizes are schematic - the PCB, ESP32 and OLED are drawn smaller relative to the box than a real build.
parts of the retrofit unit, as listed on the slide
Enclosure: base, lid, standoffs, bulkhead fittings
* the slide gives no quantity for item 6; one MOSFET + one flyback diode per valve is assumed here.

Part thumbnails: Components101 (ESP32, YF-S201), DFRobot (TDS, turbidity, buck converter), Adafruit (valve, MOSFET, diode, adapter), Makerguides (OLED). Photos belong to their owners; the exploded drawing is original.
